Welcome to Palmetto Diamond, an independent home for South Carolina high school baseball.

Explore school pages, team rosters, region standings, original stories, and statistical leaders as coverage expands.

Scores and statistics will appear after verified games are entered. School rosters currently shown are provisional and will be updated before the season.
